How the date window moves: quickset explained.

Quickset lets you change the date without moving the hands. Avoid setting it from 9 p.m. to 3 a.m., and check your manual, as some movements run until 4 a.m.

Quickset movements include the Miyota 8215, Seiko NH05 and Seiko NH36.

Source: Rotate Watches, rotatewatches.com (read 2026-11-25).
